name: Blog Auto-Publish (Mon/Wed/Fri)

# Publishes a new blog post and pushes it to main (which triggers Cloudflare).
#
# IMPORTANT — why there is NO continue-on-error on the generate step:
# The old workflow marked the generation step `continue-on-error: true`. When the
# AI step failed it exited non-zero, the step showed as a soft warning, and the
# JOB STILL TURNED GREEN. So the Actions tab said "success" while nothing was
# published for days — exactly the "shows published but nothing happens" bug.
# The generate step now fails the job loudly, and a separate notify step raises
# an issue so the outage is impossible to miss.

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 14 * * 1,3,5'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  issues: write

concurrency:
  group: daily-blog
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  generate-blog:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'

      - name: Install sharp
        run: npm install --no-save sharp

      - name: Generate today's blog post
        id: gen
        env:
          GROQ_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GROQ_API_KEY }}
          GEMINI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GEMINI_API_KEY }}
          DEEPSEEK_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEEPSEEK_API_KEY }}
          INDEXNOW_KEY: ${{ secrets.INDEXNOW_KEY }}
          # The script falls back to the site's own /api/gemini proxy when no
          # key is visible, so publishing keeps working even with zero secrets.
          SITE_API_FALLBACK: '1'
        run: node scripts/generate-blog.mjs

      - name: Ping search engines
        if: success()
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          curl -s "https://www.google.com/ping?sitemap=https://aitoolsnova.com/sitemap.xml" || true
          curl -s "https://www.bing.com/ping?sitemap=https://aitoolsnova.com/sitemap.xml" || true

      - name: Open issue if publishing failed
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const title = `🚨 Blog auto-publish failed — ${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}`;
            const runUrl = `https://github.com/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/actions/runs/${context.runId}`;
            const body = [
              'The scheduled blog post did **not** publish. The run went red instead of silently staying green.',
              '',
              `- Run: ${runUrl}`,
              `- Commit: ${context.sha}`,
              '',
              'Most common cause: no AI provider is reachable (all of Groq / Gemini / DeepSeek returned errors and the site API fallback also failed).',
              '',
              'Fix (2 min): GitHub repo → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → make sure at least one of `GROQ_API_KEY` (free at https://console.groq.com/keys), `GEMINI_API_KEY` or `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` is set as a **repository** secret (not an Environment secret). Then Actions → Blog Auto-Publish → Run workflow.',
            ].join('\n');
            const existing = await github.rest.issues.list({
              owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo,
              state: 'open', labels: ['publish-failure'], per_page: 5,
            });
            if (existing.data.length === 0) {
              await github.rest.issues.create({
                owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo,
                title, body, labels: ['publish-failure', 'automation'],
              });
            }
